identity: ONE original white-haired young gunner, the Sunvault Zenith Lensbearer, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the short swept white hair, the small blue monocle lens over one eye, the ivory and navy long coat with gold trim and star emblems, the gold shoulder and knee armour, the gold boots and the tall gold lantern standard with a blue crystal mounted on the back. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Both hands hold ONE long gold and glass lens cannon with glowing blue crystal rings, held at the waist and pointing to screen right. Preserve the lens cannon, the back standard, the coat and the proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, the back standard, the whole lens cannon, the coat tails, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, beams, muzzle flash, glow bursts, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the lens cannon stays rigid and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady, watchful idle that loops. The gunner breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the lens cannon dips a little and lifts as the grip resettles, the head turns slightly to scan and the coat tails stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no firing.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE cannon bash toward screen right. The gunner draws the lens cannon back as the knees bend, then lunges forward and rams its muzzle out to full reach at screen right with both hands, draws back and settles into the original stance. One bash only; nothing is fired and no effect appears at contact.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Fire ONE shot toward screen right. The gunner raises the lens cannon to the shoulder and sights along it toward screen right, holds the aim, then the cannon kicks up and back with the recoil, holds a moment, then the gunner lowers it to the waist in the original stance. One shot only; no beam, flash, glow or projectile is shown.

hit_h3_v1.action: The gunner starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The head and shoulders are thrown back, the coat swings and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the lens cannon, then the gunner steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low and brace the lens cannon crosswise in front of the body as a guard, the head lowered behind it, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No firing and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A quick adjustment. The gunner holds the lens cannon in one hand and raises the other hand to the monocle, turning it to sight, holds the pose briefly, then returns the hand to the cannon in the original stance. A physical gesture only: no glow, beam or effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly. The gunner sinks down onto the knees with the lens cannon dropping, stays there a moment, then slumps forward and lies flat on the front, finishing motionless with the head at screen right, the back standard still strapped on and the lens cannon on the ground beside the body. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
